description: This file contains the PHP class 'Online' which extends the base Controller class within the OpenCart admin report namespace. It defines methods for displaying online report data, including index and list functions, and internal methods for retrieving filtered online customer data. The class manages URL parameters, pagination, and data retrieval from models.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: The 'Online' controller class manages the display and filtering of online customer sessions within the OpenCart admin report section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial entry point for the online report page; sets up language, page title, URL filters, breadcrumbs, loads models, fetches data, and renders the 'online' view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the AJAX or API call to retrieve a paginated list of online customer sessions, applies filters, and returns a rendered view with a list.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Internal method that fetches filtered online customer data from models, processes customer information, and prepares the data array for the list view.
